items.title: The Next Palantir? 100 Federal Agencies Already Use Cloudflare, and It’s Cleared For More
items.summary: Cloudflare just cleared the government's highest civilian security bar, giving it access to contracts it was previously locked out of entirely. Whether that clearance turns into the kind of compounding federal revenue Palantir built depends on a template that has worked exactly once so far.

items.title: Meta Continues to Trade Jobs for AI: Robots Are “Coming For Us All”
items.summary: Meta is quietly testing robots inside its data centers, and at least one employee believes physical workers are no longer safe from automation. The experiment hints at a much larger shift in how AI spending could reshape labor costs across the entire economy.
